outcome: late onset culture positive bloodstream infection (CPBSI)
cohort: The study included 36,573 preterm infants less than 33 weeks gestational age admitted to Canadian Neonatal Intensive Care Units (NICUs) from 2010 to 2018.
finding: There was a decreasing trend in the incidence of late onset CPBSI but not late onset meningitis, and late onset meningitis was associated with IVH grade 3 or above.
